WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    raceId,
    AVG(points) as avg_points,
    AVG(wins) as avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points >= 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
),
overall_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg
  FROM race_averages
  WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ra.raceId,
  ra.avg_points,
  ra.avg_wins,
  CASE WHEN ra.avg_wins IS NOT NULL
    THEN ra.avg_wins - oa.overall_avg
  END as difference
FROM race_averages ra
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_wins oa
WHERE oa.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  difference IS NULL,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
